title: Free way to automate trading setup detection?
author: vlerx

comments.author: paulf280
comments.body: Morning mate, not sure what your setup is and what it looks for but I have a tool I developed that might help [Cabal-Hunter — Solana Token Cabal Detection](https://api.cabal-hunter.com/) it looks out for so many different aspects of tokens in the crypto space. There is a live bubble map demo, remove the mint address it populates and add one you're interested in and it will pull up all you need to know. All the GitHub and API links are in there too. Have a great day and best of luck with your trading.
